scope: Static transformed arc record-update contract and inferred CRT classifier; synthetic checks are not native numerical replay

transform.frame: Twelve binary64 values in row-major 3x4 layout, R and translation t
transform.coordinateScope: Local/external relative to the supplied frame; complete caller-to-sketch/world mapping and units remain unestablished
transform.worldPoint: R*p+t, with separate binary64 multiplication/addition in decoded order
transform.localCandidate: R transpose*(worldPoint-t), with Y term added before X term, then Z term; this is not a general matrix inverse
transform.admission: More than three point records; each transformed stored defining point differs from proposed records 0/1/2 by squared distance strictly below 1e-5
transform.fastPath: Convert record 3 to local; subtract stored center; add the resulting delta to stored center and all three defining points, rebuild records and resynchronize geometry
transform.slowPath: Convert records 0/1/2 to local and call existing setter with these three points, the supplied frame, and false final flag

classifier.binding: Eight consistent static IAT pointers minus exact installed export RVAs; derived, not a fresh live byte comparison
classifier.callerComparison: cmp AX,2 branches to false return
classifier.meaningIfReached: Rejects NaN bit patterns; these classifier checks alone do not reject infinity
classifier.preliminaryComisdExceptionBehavior: May raise invalid operation under unmasked exceptions before reaching the classifier; native MXCSR was not captured
